title: Sandymount Tower
html_source: As Cortez67 points out – this is not Stephen’s home which is the Martello Tower at Sandycove further along the coast.

anchor.prefix: unted, changed trolley, started for Blackrock, Kingstown and Dalkey, Clonskea, Rathgar and Terenure, Palmerston Park and upper Rathmines, Sandymount Green, Rathmines, Ringsend and
anchor.suffix:
, Harold's Cross. The hoarse Dublin United Tramway Company's timekeeper bawled them off: 

 — Rathgar and Terenure! 

 — Come on, Sandymount Green! 

 Right and left parallel clang
